name: Cervical Isometric Lateral Flexion
steps: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed and spine upright.
Place the palm of your left hand flat against the left side of your head just above your ear.
Gently push your head sideways to the left as if attempting to tilt your ear to your shoulder.
Provide equal resistance with your hand so your head stays perfectly upright and still.
Hold the static contraction for 5 to 10 seconds while breathing naturally.
Slowly release, rest for a moment, and repeat on the right side.
coaching_cues: Keep your eyes looking straight ahead and do not let your head rotate.
Avoid raising your shoulder up toward your ear to cheat the movement.
Use gentle, steady force (no more than 40% maximum effort).
